continuity: Jongni Chu is a young Peak martial artist from Yunnan who conceals his sect, has just coined Always-Victorious Sword as his own epithet, and immediately pursues friendship with Jin Taekyung.
Jongni Chu knows Taekyung as the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi and the Fire King's Disciple, and learned of Taekyung's killing of the Red-Killing Axe from Geumwa Merchant Group merchants.
A rumor states that Nangong Ok, the Nangong Family's Sword Dragon, will not attend this Star-Array Grand Banquet; the reason is unknown.

Taekyung washed in stream water heated by Scorching Yang Qi but still wears rags; at a cloth shop he was mistaken for a beggar and confronted by a bamboo-hatted martial artist later identified as Hyuk Mujin.
plot: Jin Taekyung meets Jongni Chu, an unusually friendly Peak master from Yunnan who immediately declares them friends, recognizes Taekyung as the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi and the Fire King's Disciple, and claims the newly invented epithet Always-Victorious Sword while concealing his sect. Jongni follows Taekyung until Taekyung names the Star-Array Grand Banquet as their next meeting place, then enters an inn whose waiter had rejected Taekyung but welcomes him and confirms that seats are available. After washing in stream water heated with Scorching Yang Qi, Taekyung hears rumors that Nangong Ok will not attend the banquet. Still dressed in rags, he is mistaken for a beggar at a luxury cloth shop, starts a confrontation with the employees, and recognizes the bamboo-hatted martial artist who intervenes as Hyuk Mujin; Taekyung gives Mujin three seconds to put his head on the ground.
translation_decisions: Render 종리추 as Jongni Chu, 상승검 as Always-Victorious Sword, 운남 as Yunnan, and 마이클 존슨 as Michael Johnson.
Render 경공 as light-body arts and preserve Jongni Chu's overly familiar, relentlessly positive voice.

active_continuity: Jeok Cheongang publicly recognizes Jin Taekyung as his Disciple and heir to the Fire Gate Clan's orthodox lineage.
Taekyung remains bound to chained Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron balls whose key Jeok holds.
Jeok Cheongang's dementia and age-related weakness continue to progress.
Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang reached Henan after leaving the Nangong Family estate in Anhui, but Jeok has now separated from Taekyung and gone to Shaolin alone.
The Azure Sky Sword King is Nangong Cheon, Grand Family Head of the Nangong Family, and he has reached nine-tenths mastery of the Emperor's Sword Form without achieving Great Completion.
Namgung Ryong is the Family Head of the Namgung family and commands the Hidden Thread and Lesser Threads.
Nangong Ok is Namgung Ryong's only child, the Nangong Family's Lesser Family Head and the Sword Dragon.
Taekyung accepted the Three-Move Kill Sudden Quest, removed his chained iron balls before Namgung Cheon's attack, and withstood three moves of the Emperor's Sword Form.
Jeok Cheongang has achieved the Five Qi Returning to Origin realm and regards Taekyung as a Hidden Dragon while regarding himself as the dragon pearl.
Namgung Cheon ordered Namgung Ryong to keep Nangong Ok away from the Star-Array Grand Banquet.
Heuk Jongpil, former leader of Black Mountain Stronghold, is dead after an unidentified hidden master killed him in One Strike.
Black Mountain Stronghold paid four-tenths of its monthly profits to the Green Forest Alliance; its surviving bandits were handed to the authorities by the Geumwa Merchant Group.
The Star-Array Grand Banquet is three days away, and Henan's streets and inns are overcrowded.
Song Ho, the Thousand-Faced Fox, is an elderly and physically powerful martial artist with a wooden prosthetic leg who is investigating the hidden master.
Jeok Cheongang took Taekyung's coin purse, went alone to Shaolin, and forbade Taekyung from following until the Kaifeng preliminary competition.
Taekyung cannot find lodging in Henan and is mistaken for a beggar because of his ragged clothes, tangled hair, and concealed chains.
Jongni Chu is a young Peak martial artist from Yunnan who conceals his sect, has just coined Always-Victorious Sword as his own epithet, and immediately pursues friendship with Taekyung.
Jongni Chu knows Taekyung as the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi and the Fire King's Disciple, and learned of his killing of the Red-Killing Axe from Geumwa merchants.
Rumors say Nangong Ok will not attend this Star-Array Grand Banquet, but the reason is unknown.

Taekyung washed in stream water heated by Scorching Yang Qi but still wears rags; at a cloth shop he was mistaken for a beggar and confronted by a bamboo-hatted martial artist later identified as Hyuk Mujin.
open_questions: How quickly will Jeok Cheongang's dementia progress, and how much time does he have to teach Taekyung?
Why has Namgung Ryong committed the family's intelligence network to investigating Taekyung?
What important matter does Jin Wikyung need to discuss privately with Jeok Cheongang?
Did Mae Jonghak actually grant Cheongpung permission to become Jeok's Disciple, and will Baek Museong escort Cheongpung to Huashan or search the Central Plains for Mae?
What is the unknowable calamity approaching as the heavenly patterns become distorted?
What does Dark Heaven intend, and how is it connected to the approaching calamity?
Who was the hidden master who killed Heuk Jongpil, and why did he do so?
Why will Nangong Ok miss the Star-Array Grand Banquet, and what reason and intention lie behind Jongni Chu's concealed sect?

profile_creations.personality: Approachable, eccentric, relentlessly positive, and unusually eager to form friendships; treats even severe verbal abuse as proof of genuine friendship.
profile_creations.relationships: Immediately declares Jin Taekyung his friend after meeting him, follows him through Henan, and intends to see him again at the Star-Array Grand Banquet.
profile_creations.role: Young Peak martial artist from Yunnan; conceals his sect and has just coined the self-styled epithet Always-Victorious Sword.
profile_creations.voice: Friendly, casually familiar, cheerful, and shamelessly persistent.
